title: Membrane Committee
description: Synthetic toy simulation (classical software, not physical holography hardware): a heterogeneous committee of holographic membranes at different coarse-graining resolutions voting on noisy probes. Negative result: majority, confidence-weighted and reliability-weighted voting do not beat the best single member at low-to-moderate noise and only marginally exceed it near chance, while the oracle gap shows the ensemble holds unused information. Version 0.2.0 adds per-member refusal gates, measured over 20 seed sets: refusal lowers committee accuracy (by 0.025 at the calibration noise level and about 0.14 under noise shift), wrong votes are only weakly separable from right ones by overlap, and a gate calibrated on right versus wrong votes does worse.
